title: The hosts saw a green orb with Elizondo at his Wyoming home
summary: Jesse Michels tells of The hosts saw a green orb with Elizondo at his Wyoming home, about a couple of years before 2024 at Elizondo's place, Wyoming, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: we saw a green orb with you I don't know you remember that it was it was night time

plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host, says that a couple of years before 2024 he and his team were at the Wyoming home of Lue Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who ran a small office studying unexplained aerial reports and wrote a book called Imminent. Michels says that one night they all saw a green glowing orb together. If true, it would put the host himself among the witnesses.
